Description: Identified a pattern that may indicate AWS credentials, risking unauthorized cloud resource access and data breaches on AWS platforms.
Author: Jimmie Coleman
Message:
feat: add best-practice playbooks from GP-CONSULTING (540 files, 8 packages)

Copies industry-standard playbooks, policy templates, fixer scripts,
and tool configs from GP-CONSULTING into the Portfolio's GP-copilot
directory. Organized into 8 engagement packages:

  01: APP-SEC — 16 scanners, fixers, scanning configs, pre-commit hooks
  02: CLUSTER-HARDENING — Kyverno/Conftest/Gatekeeper, golden path, Karpenter
  03: DEPLOY-RUNTIME — Falco rules, watchers, responders, observability
  04: KUBESTER — 13 specialist playbooks, CKA/CKAD/CKS reference
  05: JSA-AUTONOMOUS — Agent engagement playbooks (4 variants)
  06: CLOUD-SECURITY — AWS migration, Terraform, VPC patterns, FinOps
  07: FEDRAMP-READY — NIST 800-53, SSP/POA&M templates, scanning configs
  08: VENDOR-INTEGRATION — CrowdStrike/Wiz/Prisma playbooks, adapter scaffold

Proprietary files excluded: NPC framework, rank system, escalation
matrices, agent workflows, JADE/Katie configs, triage engine, vendor
deduplication internals.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
